blocks.text: Surrey Townhomes Under $1.2M: the housing stock

items.t: Stock in this band is strata townhome stock: Surrey's utility page carries a separate rate table headed "Annual flat rates for multi-family residential (strata)," the billing class a townhome complex falls under, distinct from the single-family and secondary suite tables.

Newer band stock follows Fraser Highway: the Surrey Langley SkyTrain project's May 2026 status report describes Fleetwood Station, at 160 Street and Fraser Highway, as sitting in the heart of Fleetwood Town Centre, surrounded by residential neighbourhoods.

blocks.text: Surrey Townhomes Under $1.2M: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A short-term rental in a Surrey townhome is owner-only: only the property owner may host, the owner must live at the property as their primary residence, tenants cannot operate one, and a principal-residence whole townhouse is one of the permitted forms.

Hosting needs a City business licence first, at $358 per year plus any applicable application fees; the provincial frame since May 1, 2024 also limits rentals to the host's principal residence plus one suite or accessory unit on the same property.

blocks.text: Surrey Townhomes Under $1.2M: development and new projects

items.t: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension is named once here, at pointer level: it extends the Expo Line 16 kilometres from King George Station to 203 Street in Langley City, mostly along Fraser Highway, with Fleetwood Station at 160 Street; status: under construction, May 2026 status report (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Surrey Townhomes Under $1.2M: costs and taxes

items.t: The band straddles the newly built ceiling: below $1,100,000 a qualifying new townhome pays no property transfer tax, between $1,100,000 and $1,150,000 the exemption is proportionally reduced, and at $1,150,000 it is gone.

A first-time buyer's GST saving tops out inside this band: the Department of Finance states the rebate saves up to $50,000, applies to agreements entered into on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031, and its bill received Royal Assent on March 12, 2026.

Band-priced townhomes along Fraser Highway gain stations, not just buses: the SkyTrain status report lists eight new stations west to east from Green Timbers (140 Street) through Fleetwood (160 Street) to Langley City Centre, on an elevated guideway along Fraser Highway.

blocks.text: Surrey Townhomes Under $1.2M: risks and due diligence

items.t: A newly built exemption must be kept, not just claimed: the Province requires the buyer to move in within 92 days of registration at the Land Title Office and keep occupying the home as a principal residence for the rest of the first year.

The GST rebate has a contract-date window: the Canada Revenue Agency's registrant guide states it applies where the builder agreement was entered into on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031, with construction substantially completed before 2036, so an older presale contract in this band may fall outside it.

faq.q: What if the townhome is newly built?
faq.a: A new townhome can escape the tax entirely at the right price. The Province's newly built home exemption page states the full exemption threshold rose to $1,100,000 on April 1, 2024, the exemption phases out over the next $50,000, and it is completely eliminated at $1,150,000, so a new townhome between $1,150,000 and $1.2 million gets none.

faq.q: Is there GST relief on a new townhome here?
faq.a: Yes, and this band is where it is strongest. The Canada Revenue Agency guide states first-time home buyers may be eligible, combined with the new housing rebate, for a rebate of 100 percent of the Goods and Services Tax (GST) on homes valued at or under $1 million, gradually reduced between $1 million and $1.5 million, with none at $1.5 million or more.

faq.q: Can I rent the townhome short-term while living elsewhere?
faq.a: No, Surrey ties the rental to the owner's own home. The City requires the host to be the property owner, requires that owner to reside at the property as their primary residence, and bars tenants from operating a short-term rental, so an investor-held townhome in this band cannot be run as one.

faq.q: Which schools serve a townhome address in this band?
faq.a: The address decides, not the complex or the price. Surrey Schools (School District 36) maintains a School Catchment Locator page for looking up the catchment schools for a specific home address, and a buyer should run the exact townhome address through it before removing subjects on an offer.

faq.q: Can a first-time buyer avoid property transfer tax on a townhome on this page?
faq.a: On price alone, in the lower part of the band: the first time home buyers' program exempts a qualifying purchaser on the first $500,000 of the purchase price, its full exemption requires a fair market value of $835,000 or less and a partial exemption may apply to $860,000 — townhomes above $860,000 are outside it on price, though the program's other conditions still have to be met either way.
